teacher_walkthrough: We plot a cumulative frequency graph for the travel times of 200 drivers.

Step 1: Identify the coordinates to plot.
In cumulative frequency graphs, cumulative frequencies are plotted at the upper boundary of each interval:
- $(0, 0)$ as the starting point
- $(10, 16)$
- $(20, 50)$
- $(30, 106)$
- $(50, 146)$
- $(70, 176)$
- $(90, 200)$
Step 2: Plot the points accurately on the provided grid with appropriately labelled axes.
Step 3: Connect the points with a smooth, continuous, increasing curve.

teacher_walkthrough: We need to find the travel time $T$ such that 80 drivers took at least $T$ minutes.

Step 1: Relate the condition to cumulative frequency.
Cumulative frequency measures the number of observations less than or equal to a given value.
If $80$ drivers took $T$ minutes or longer, then:
$$200 - 80 = 120\text{ drivers}$$
took strictly less than $T$ minutes.

Step 2: Read the value from the graph:
Locate $120$ on the vertical cumulative frequency axis, trace across to intersect the curve, and read down to the horizontal time axis:
$$T = 37\text{ minutes}$$
(Any reading in the accepted range of $36$ to $39$ minutes is creditworthy).

skill_tags: Estimating a Mean from Grouped Data

hints: Find the frequency for each interval by subtracting consecutive cumulative frequencies: $16, 34, 56, 40, 30, 24$.
Divide $\sum f x$ by the total number of drivers ($200$).
walkthrough:
Obtain the frequency ($f$) and class midpoint ($x$) for each time interval:
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Interval} & \text{Midpoint } (x) & \text{Frequency } (f) & f \times x \\
\hline
0 - 10 & 5 & 16 & 80 \\
10 - 20 & 15 & 50 - 16 = 34 & 510 \\
20 - 30 & 25 & 106 - 50 = 56 & 1400 \\
30 - 50 & 40 & 146 - 106 = 40 & 1600 \\
50 - 70 & 60 & 176 - 146 = 30 & 1800 \\
70 - 90 & 80 & 200 - 176 = 24 & 1920 \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Sum the products to obtain $\sum f x$:
$$\sum f x = 80 + 510 + 1400 + 1600 + 1800 + 1920 = 7310$$

Divide by total frequency $n = 200$:
$$\overline{x} = \frac{\sum f x}{\sum f} = \frac{7310}{200} = 36.55 \approx 36.6\text{ minutes}$$

ai_rubric.Estimating a Mean from Grouped Data: Finds frequencies 16, 34, 56, 40, 30, 24 with midpoints 5, 15, 25, 40, 60, 80, sums fx = 7310, and divides by 200 to obtain 36.55 or 36.6 minutes.

teacher_walkthrough: We estimate the mean travel time for all 200 drivers from the cumulative frequency table.

Step 1: Calculate the individual frequency for each class interval by subtracting successive cumulative frequencies:
- Interval $0 - 10$: $f_1 = 16$
- Interval $10 - 20$: $f_2 = 50 - 16 = 34$
- Interval $20 - 30$: $f_3 = 106 - 50 = 56$
- Interval $30 - 50$: $f_4 = 146 - 106 = 40$
- Interval $50 - 70$: $f_5 = 176 - 146 = 30$
- Interval $70 - 90$: $f_6 = 200 - 176 = 24$

Step 2: Determine the class midpoints:
- Midpoint of $0 - 10$: $5$
- Midpoint of $10 - 20$: $15$
- Midpoint of $20 - 30$: $25$
- Midpoint of $30 - 50$: $40$
- Midpoint of $50 - 70$: $60$
- Midpoint of $70 - 90$: $80$

Step 4: Divide by the total frequency $200$:
$$\overline{x} = \frac{7310}{200} = 36.55\text{ minutes}$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $36.6\text{ minutes}$.
